_comment: Bluesky is the live source and needs no token — just the account handle (e.g. 'benditofantasy.bsky.social', or a custom-domain handle). Threads/Instagram are optional: fill their numeric user IDs (from the Meta Graph API Explorer) and set THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN / IG_ACCESS_TOKEN env vars (repo secrets in CI) to enable them. Leave any field blank to skip that platform.
